capabilities: Build daily Markdown digests with source, time and original links
Track a topic and append later coverage to a timeline
Analyze items with AI, separating facts, inferences and judgments
extras: Optional macOS service adds hotlists, full-text enrichment, clustering, timelines, judgments and scheduled 07:00/19:00 runs; it listens on 127.0.0.1 with a token and the plugin never spawns processes. No telemetry; AI requests go only to the configured provider. Can be installed via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to follow RSS feeds or hotlists and turn daily coverage into a tracked, analyzed digest.

requires.name: Under the Sun local enhancement service (macOS)

summary: RSS and hotlist reader that builds a trackable daily Markdown digest and adds AI analysis of facts, sources and conflicts.
